Us Khuda ka naam le kar padho jis ne paida kiya hai
Us ne insaan ko jame hue khoon se paida kiya hai
Padho, aur tumhaara Parwardigar bada kareem hai
Jis ne qalam ke zariye taaleem di hai
Aur insaan ko woh sab kuchh bata diya hai jo use nahin maaloom tha
Ke apne ko be-niyaaz khayaal karta hai
Be-shak aap ke Rabb ki taraf waapasi hai
Kya tum ne us shakhs ko dekha hai jo mana karta hai
Banda-e-Khuda ko jab woh namaaz padhta hai
Kya tum ne dekha ke agar woh banda hidaayat par ho
Ya taqwa ka hukm de to rokna kaisa hai
Kya tum ne dekha ke agar is kaafir ne jhutlaaya aur munh pher liya
To kya tumhein nahin maaloom ke Allah dekh raha hai
Yaad rakho agar woh rokne se baaz na aaya to hum peshaani ke baal pakad kar ghaseetenge
Jhoote aur khata-kaar ki peshaani ke baal
Phir woh apne hum-nasheenon ko bulaaye
Hum bhi apne jallaad farishton ko bulaate hain
Dekho tum hargiz us ki itaa'at na karna aur sajda kar ke qurb-e-Khuda haasil karo
